description: Work with items in an object library: Add Item (store page items as one item), Add Items on Page (as one item or each separately), Place Item(s) into the document, Update Library Item with page items, Item Information (name, type, description), and Delete Item(s) (Library panel menu)

items.description: place, update, info, delete: Which library items: ids or names (manage_object_library with action "list" shows both)

names.description: Library item names (every item with each name)

library.description: Name of an open library, as the Library panel tab shows it (e.g. "Parts.indl"); default: the first open library

pageIndex.description: add_page: the page whose items are stored (0-based)

separately.description: add_page: store each item on the page as its own library item

target.description: add, update: the page items to store. Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_page_items, or the id a create tool returns), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: manage_library_items
title: Manage Library Items
